Message:
ipv6: Create RTF_CACHE clone when FLOWI_FLAG_KNOWN_NH is set

This patch always creates RTF_CACHE clone with DST_NOCACHE
when FLOWI_FLAG_KNOWN_NH is set so that the rt6i_dst is set to
the fl6->daddr.
